I called the clinic on such short notice yesterday afternoon around 17::40 hoping i can get doll eyes treatment before fly back to Bangkok today and to my surprise, they were so kind and accommodating — they even opened a bit earlier just for me! I couldn’t believe it. The whole team is absolutely amazing — so warm, so caring, and truly professional. From the moment I arrived, I felt so well looked after.

The nurses were beyond wonderful — one of them gently held my hand when I was feeling scared, and another carefully placed ice blocks on my face to make sure I was comfortable. Their kindness and patience meant the world to me. It’s rare to find a team that not only does their job so well but also genuinely cares for their patients the way they do.

And Dr. Ploy… she is simply brilliant. So gentle, understanding, and incredibly skilled at what she does. I felt completely safe in her hands, and the result — oh my goodness — it’s absolutely amazing!

Thank you so much to the entire team for making what could have been a nerve-wracking experience into something so positive and comforting. I’m beyond grateful and will definitely be coming back again ❤️

I also got massertox and both of the procedures were painless for me- they iced me very well before each procedure. Khob khun kha ladies, thank you!!

He took time from his schedule at the hospital to do a check up on me 3 days after my treatment. I can’t thank the staff enough at this clinic for how good they have been to me. The clinic is clean and professional. I highly recommend. Thank you everyone at AM Clinic.

I came to the clinic feeling very nervous and unsure at first, but from the moment I walked in, the entire team made me feel completely at ease. The nurses were just as wonderful — so patient, caring, and genuinely attentive. They treated me with such warmth and kindness that all my worries disappeared.

And the results… oh my goodness, I’m beyond thrilled! I honestly didn’t expect it to turn out this amazing. I feel so happy and confident, and I can’t stop smiling when I look in the mirror.

Thank you so much to Dr. Ploy and the entire team — you truly made my experience unforgettable! 💕
